notes: Literal summand a(k) fails at n=1 (11/2>1); with summand a(k-1) the claim is equivalent to R. Israel's 2017 formula Sum_{k<=n} a(k-1)/(2k)! = 1-1/(2n)! (telescoping). Lean main theorem A082108_isGreatest. Outside Lean: none.

prior_art.oeis_status: conjecture removed from entry; formula present

sources.cite: R. Israel, formula in OEIS A082108 (Jul 19 2017)
sources.what: Sum_{k=1..n} a(k-1)/(2k)! = 1 - 1/(2n)!, which implies the claim
